## Research interests

- Geological remote sensing
- Hyperspectral imaging
- LiDAR–hyperspectral data fusion
- Mineral exploration and smart mining
- Planetary geology
- Lunar and Martian rover payloads for in-situ geological observation
- Underground and ground-based remote sensing
- Rover and robotic-platform near-field remote sensing

## Technical expertise

- **Hyperspectral remote sensing:** VNIR–SWIR preprocessing, radiometric calibration, georeferencing, endmember extraction, target detection, classification, and spectral mapping
- **Sensors and platforms:** ground, UAV, satellite, and planetary hyperspectral data; LiDAR, IMU, stereo imaging, and field spectrometry
- **Geospatial and scientific computing:** Python, PyTorch, MATLAB, IDL, ENVI, ArcGIS, QGIS, SNAP, ISIS, CloudCompare, and Linux-based workflows
- **System development:** hyperspectral payload integration, embedded computing, and mobile sensing platforms
